title: T-Shirt (Unisex)
description: A vibrant crewneck for all shapes and sizes. Made from 100% cotton.

sku_id: Required. The product’s unique ID as defined by the merchant. Character limit: 100. Catalogs cannot contain duplicate sku’s.
title: Required. The product’s name. Character limit: 500. Matches the product title on the product’s landing page.
description: Required. Details to describe the product. Character limit: 10,000.
availability: Required. Accepted values: In stock, Available, Preorder, Out of stock, Discontinued
condition: Required. Accepted values: New, Refurbished, or Used
price: Required. Currency much match the catalog's default currency. Example: 9.99 USD
link: Required. A link to the product. Starts with http or https.
image_link: Required. A link to the product's main image. Starts with with http, https. ≥ 500*500 pixels, JPG or PNG format. Do not upscale or upload thumbnails. Do not upload placeholders or generic images. Do not include watermarks.
brand: Optional. The product’s brand. Character limit: 150.
video_link: Optional. Starts with http or https. A video of your product. Recommend 9:16 aspect ratio, ≥ 720*1280 resolution, ≥ 516kbps bitrate. Sound: enabled with captions included.
additional_image_link: Optional. Additional image links for the product. No more than 10 images. use a comma to separate each link.
age_group: Optional. Accepted values: Newborn, Infant, Toddler, Kids, Adult
color: Optional. The color of each product. Character limit: 100
gender: Optional. Accepted values: Male, Female, Unisex
item_group_id: Optional. Also known as SPU. Required if using TikTok shop.
google_product_category: Optional. A preset value from Google's product taxonomy. https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6324436?hl=en
product_type: For example: Home > Women > Dresses > Maxi Dresses. Three levels supported. Ideally aligned with Google category format.
sale_price: Optional. Price & currency must match the price from your landing page.
sale_price_effective_date: Optional. The time period the sale price is effective. Format: 2027-12-01T0:00/2027-12-31T0:00. Use with sale price. If not provided, sale price always applies.
shipping: Optional. Suggested format: COUNTRY:STATE:SHIPPING_TYPE:PRICE:SERVICE. Use ":" to separate different regions, use ";" to separate different costs. Example: “US:CA:Ground:9.99 USD:Standard”
shipping_weight: Optional. Format: "number + unit". Accepted units: lb, oz, kg, g
gtin: Optional. The global trade ID number
size: Optional. The size of each product
tax: Optional. The applicable tax for the product
ios_url: Optional. The product / app’s iOS URL
ios_app_store_id: Optional. App store ID and iOS URL should direct to the same app.
ios_app_name: Optional. Must match the iOS app store ID and direct to the same app.
iPhone_app_store_id: Optional. The iPhone app store ID
iPhone_app_name: Optional. The name of each iPhone app
iPad_app_store_id: Optional. The iPad app store ID
android_url: Optional. The product’s / apps Android URL.
android_package: Optional. The Android app store ID.
android_app_name: Optional. Must match the android package name.

sku_id: Remove rows 4 & 5 before uploading. Learn more: https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=10001006
